remaining_obligations.detail: Prove/refine actual Rust guest sink and HTTP adapters to W4/W5 modeled events.
Connect ensure_safe and literal-secret rejection to reflectionBlocked; review secret-dependent denial oracle.
Derive concrete error/status, frame length, pagination, connection closure and failure ordering.
Relate concrete mutable broker state, concurrency and authorized decision transitions to abstract step-preservation.
Account-status, no-preflight, legacy forwarding, OAuth startup and admin channels need separate models.

claim_note: Only conditioned equality of modeled guest replies and explicitly supplied metadata. Not secrecy of all observable status/timing, not verified native I/O, not KVM isolation.
